definitions.explanation: A Chinese-origin dish of shredded vegetables and meat wrapped in a thin wheat skin and deep-fried. A staple item on Chinese restaurant menus in Japan and a common bento side.

examples.japanese: {春巻|はるま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揚|あ}げた→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧。
⟦{中華|ちゅうか}→中華：11322_chuuka⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}{店|てん}→料理店：25626_ryouriten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{春巻|はるま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered spring rolls at the Chinese restaurant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦パリッとした→パリッとする：26984_parittosuru⟧⟦{揚|あ}げたて→揚げたて：16736_agetate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{春巻|はるま}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧だ。
examples.english: I love freshly fried spring rolls with crispy skin.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧ (spring) + {巻|ま}き (roll). The name reflects the dish's origin as a way to wrap fresh spring vegetables. In Japan the term almost always refers to the deep-fried Chinese-style roll, not the fresh Vietnamese-style {生|なま}{春巻|はるま}き.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {春巻|はるま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧: to fry spring rolls
- {春巻|はるま}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧: spring-roll wrappers
- {生|なま}{春巻|はるま}き: fresh (Vietnamese-style) spring rolls
- エビ{春巻|はるま}き: shrimp spring rolls

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧: dumpling — different shape and skin, usually pan-fried or boiled
- ⟦ロール→ロール：11709_rooru⟧⟦キャベツ→キャベツ：05187_kyabetsu⟧: cabbage roll — Western-style, simmered in broth
